messages:
emily: Heads-up: Verdant POC kickstart tomorrow 2pm PT. Need final scope, success metrics, and a short agenda.
raj: Data sources? They said S3 chat logs + Zendesk export. Any redaction needs?
verdant-poc-pm: Correct. ~7GB total. Must remove payment tokens and personal email addresses before ingest. We'll provide a sanitized sample and a manifest.
sam-se: Use cases: 1) automated triage + routing label, 2) canned reply generator for support, 3) FAQ retrieval for help center widget.
emily: Proposed success criteria draft:
- Triage accuracy (macro F1) >= 0.82 on 300 holdout tickets
- Generated reply appropriateness score >= 4/5 in manual review of 60 cases
- Latency: p95 < 450ms for generate endpoint during 1k QPS test
- Safety: no PII in 5k generated outputs (automated check)
- Ops: <1% error rate in 48h soak at expected load
raj: Add model-fallback acceptance: quantized variant allowed if similarity >= 92% vs golden set.
verdant-poc-pm: Timeline preference: 10 business days. Week1 ingest + baseline, week2 tuning + UAT, final 2 days stress + handoff.
finance-bot: Customer wants committed capacity pricing if they move to dedicated at 12k msgs/day. We need average tokens per interaction.
sam-se: Estimate: 60 input tokens, 140 output tokens average. Finance, can you draft a provisional cost table by EOD?
finance-bot: Drafting now; will post spreadsheet link in thread. Need billing contact and tentative PO info.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire submitted: https://sec.redwood.example/sq/19912 1 items flagged for legal ops.
verdant-poc-pm: They require DPA signed prior to data transfer and 30-day retention for POC. Also need an IP allowlist for their staging env.
emily: Action items: ops to produce IP allowlist template + onboarding script; legal to start DPA; finance to draft committed pricing; SE to prepare prompt pack + eval harness.
sam-se: Ingest example command we'll provide:
```bash
redwood ingest --source s3://verdant-poc/sanitized --role redwood-poc-readonly --redact patterns.json --retention 30d
```
Also initial prompt seeds:
1) "Label ticket with {priority: low|med|high} and one-sentence rationale"
2) "Generate a concise agent reply (<=45 words) that escalates if severity=high"
3) "Return {customer_name, product, error_code} as JSON"
emily: We'll run automated evals on 400 held-out cases + manual review of 50 replies. Can we lock success criteria and agenda in this thread by 12pm PT today?
verdant-poc-pm: 12pm works. One ask: for POC they prefer hosted trial but need a short-lived cost dashboard showing token spend. Can we provide that?
raj: Yes, we can generate a dashboard link for the trial window. Also confirm they accept KMS-managed keys for POC; HSM for prod later.
verdant-poc-pm: KMS is fine.
finance-bot: Reminder: include billing contact on kickoff agenda for PO follow-up.
emily: Great. I'll post agenda + dial-in 20m before meeting. Thanks team!
